Informativeness and logit variance plane

Source: R/plot-plane.R
plot_plane.Rd

Places one or several analyses by their informativeness and their logit variance, with contours of the leading term of the dispersion and the half of the plane where the leading term of the mean reliability minus \(I\) is positive.

Usage

plot_plane(x, level = NULL, contours = TRUE, ...)

Arguments

x

An object of class reliability_posterior, reliability_draws, reliability_profile or profile_comparison.

level

Probability content of the intervals of \(I\), a number between 0 and 1. NULL, the default, uses the level of the fits.

contours

If TRUE (the default), the contours of \(I(1 - I)V/2\) are shown.

...

Must be empty.

Value

A ggplot object.

Details

The dispersion depends on the whole profile, not on \(I\) and \(V\) alone, so the contours are those of its leading term \(\tfrac12 I(1-I)V\) (Lee, 2026, Proposition 2). Left of \(I = 1/2\) the leading term of the mean reliability minus \(I\) is positive; whether the exact difference is depends on the remainder, which local_terms() bounds.

Examples

fit <- reliability_posterior(estimate, se = se, data = eight_schools)
plot_plane(fit)
